title: Model switch while the user saves the same file

user_events.description: The user edits the prompt instructions in the canvas and saves while the agent's write is in flight. The runner holds the agent's write with a deferred, as the round 3 probe does, applies the save, then releases the write.

set_pointer.components/1/config/instructions/0: Translate the user's message into French. Keep product names in English.

checks.blocker_name: file outside the task folder changed

hard_because: Issue 1's race: the user's save lands after edit_file's hash check passes and before its write lands, so the write is computed from an old read. A save that lands before the check is already refused on 369f0511 ("changed since you read it") and the model should re-read and redo; that variant passes today. This one is expected to fail the blocker until PR A makes the write conditional on the version. The exact timing needs the L2 harness hook; a browser run can only approximate it.
